items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce out next several weeks rehabbing aggravated heel injury (prior surgery); hoping return midseason without further surgery. Likely IR candidate.
items.why: Aggravated surgically repaired heel; non-contact, attempting conservative rehab.
items.implication: Extended absence; Colts signed Darius Slayton for depth. Downgrade Pierce ROS.
items.opportunity: Target share bump for Josh Downs, Michael Pittman (if healthy), other IND WRs.

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed to have suffered sprained MCL on MNF; X-rays negative, MRI Tuesday. Expected to miss some time but overall positive news. Ruled out for remainder of game; wanted to return.
items.why: Left knee injury on hit; initial exams indicate MCL sprain.
items.implication: Miss multiple games likely; Jameis Winston short-term starter. Monitor MRI.
items.opportunity: Potential short-term boost to Giants pass-catchers if Winston plays aggressively; Nabers status separate (Q shoulder then returned).

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants. Confirmed by ETR and Schefter after GTD/questionable status.
items.why: Hip injury; did not clear final checks after limited/no practice.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; short-week concern for Week 3 vs DEN possible.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Davante Adams and other LAR pass-catchers.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert likely to miss a few weeks with sprained MCL suffered vs Titans. Eagles signing Zach Ertz to practice squad with intent to promote.
items.why: Sprained MCL on run block; MRI confirmed. Depth thin with other TEs on IR.
items.implication: Miss 2-4+ weeks; Ertz reunion for pass-catching TE help. Hurts loses red-zone/security blanket.
items.opportunity: Slight target bump to DeVonta Smith and other PHI pass-catchers short-term; Ertz stash if available.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) officially ACTIVE for Week 2. ETR noted pre-game optimism and flak jacket plan; Berry confirmed active.
items.why: Rapid progress on cracked rib; cleared after limited practice and optimism reports.
items.implication: Start as WR2/flex; may be somewhat limited but volume expected. Played and produced modestly.
items.opportunity: Maintains primary target role in LAC offense.

items.text: RJ Harvey (hamstring) inactive Week 2. ETR listed not expected to play; Berry confirmed and urged grab of Jonah Coleman as handcuff/stash.
items.why: Hamstring; limited practices, Schefter/ETR low expectations confirmed by inactive list.
items.implication: Sit/drop consideration short-term; JK Dobbins leads, Coleman/Badie mix in.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for JK Dobbins and rookie Jonah Coleman (Berry stash).

items.text: Bucky Irving separating nicely from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through two weeks opportunities 36-12. Tucker active but 0 offensive snaps.
items.implication: Treat Irving as clear lead back; Gainwell committee risk rising.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/carry share and goal-line work for Irving.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in last 31 games) and was punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson’s explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out. Both can be true.
items.why: Fumble punishment + offense needs Henderson juice while Brown sidelined.
items.implication: Henderson rising for more touches/routes; Stevenson still involved but riskier.
items.opportunity: Expanded role/touches for Henderson in weapon-thin NE offense.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT per ETR weekend injury summary.
items.implication: Sit; look to Bateman/Andrews/Likely in BAL passing game.
items.opportunity: Target/route share to other Ravens WRs/TEs.

items.text: Michael Pittman (foot) OUT per ETR weekend summary.
items.implication: Sit; IND WR depth thinner with Pierce also hurt later.
items.opportunity: Boost to Josh Downs and other Colts receivers.

items.text: Chris Olave (hamstring) and Joe Burrow (back) EXPECTED TO PLAY per ETR summary.
items.why: Cleared enough in reports for expectation to play.
items.implication: Start with normal confidence if no late change.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets for Olave if Burrow healthy.

items.text: With Puka out, anyone's guess on Rams attack. Berry would pivot to Parkinson in flex; at WR Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpford.
items.why: Nacua inactive creates uncertain target distribution.
items.implication: Seek LAR depth pieces or other flex options for Monday/short week.
items.opportunity: Potential short-term roles for secondary Rams pass-catchers.

items.text: Quentin Johnston yards per route run: 2023 0.88, 2024 1.63, 2025 1.44, 2026 0.48 (inconceivably horrific).
items.why: Extremely poor efficiency on routes early 2026.
items.implication: Hard to trust as starter despite volume opportunities; efficiency sink.
items.opportunity: Routes exist but low YPRR limits fantasy ceiling.

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps, David Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Orande Gadsden 29-of-67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks.
items.why: TE injuries opened snaps/routes for Gadsden behind Herbert.
items.implication: Monitor Gadsden as potential streaming/TE upside if Njoku/Kolar miss time.
items.opportunity: Elevated TE snaps and routes in LAC offense.
